structured_deals.economic_effect: Up to $44.6B. Tranches bill only after written acceptance; late delivery may shorten term, reduce rates or permit termination. Financing longstop is redacted and either party may terminate if qualifying GPU and facility finance is not obtained. Separate subsidiaries must coordinate shared operations and lender step-in rights; SPVs do not establish absence of parent exposure.

Up to $43.8B through 2033 excluding options. Public form has delay credits and proportional upfront refund within 60 days of specified delivery termination. Customer-provided CPU/storage/networking in separate 6MW colocation space prevents GPU-only nameplate assumptions.

Forty executed schedules as of September 4 total about $2.54B initial-term rent. Framework generally retains funder title, requires unconditional payments and return unless schedule overrides; customer acceptance risk is not automatically passed to equipment lessor.

Ward $1.85B and North Carolina $1.2B are separate projects, not Monarch financing. Maturity is earlier of final customer scheduled payment and February 27 2033 / December 27 2031 respectively. NC advance capped at lesser of 90% GPU capex and debt sized to 1.30x DSCR. Cash waterfalls/reserves constrain distributable cash.

$3.36B total: $2.36B initial tranche; $1B NVIDIA funding expected mid-November. Automatic IPO conversion creates future dilution. Do not add the S-1 $3.1B minimum subscription as separate financing or treat full $3.36B as current cash.

June 30 uncommenced lease payments $1.4B; data-center build commitments $3.5B; undelivered technology commitments $24B. Existing lease liabilities are a separate discounted perimeter. PPAs/renewable procurement described, but matched site energy costs and Monarch fuel economics are missing. Undated current issuer site page targets Monarch phase one by early 2028.
$1.65B equity consideration, subject to closing conditions including IPO; excluded from historical results. Open-source Ray adoption is not evidence of token monetization or utilization uplift.
